title: Avril Chester (12th Most Influential Woman in UK Tech / Computer Weekly) pulls Eric's line: 'I taught people how to build something worth protecting — but not how to protect it'
summary: Avril Chester — 12th Most Influential Woman in UK Tech (Computer Weekly); COO; Advisory Board; co-author 'Leading with Humanity in an AI World' — publishes a DIN Salesforce Tower recap that becomes the highest-engagement UK-tour reaction to date (56 likes, 7 comments, five days after the event). Pulls Eric's own opening self-assessment as the book's origin story.
blockquote: My book The Lean Startup gave a generation of founders the tools to build quickly, to scale, and to create massive value. But I failed to anticipate what came next. I taught people how to build something worth protecting — but not how to protect it.
blockquote_source: Avril Chester on LinkedIn, quoting Eric Ries
